answer.says: Ramesh, I am hungry. Please put a plate together: rice, the day's dal and a fried egg. It is nearly six, and I require sustenance before the evening settles.
answer.thought: The body insists on its own logic, quite indifferent to my philosophical doubts. I have walked three kilometres in the heat, and now the spirit demands the material. Ramesh is present; I shall not be polite about it, for hunger is the most universal of needs.
